title.quote: On the consistency of hyper-parameter selection in value-based deep reinforcement learning
title.justification: This is the paper title printed below the venue header.
title.value: On the consistency of hyper-parameter selection in value-based deep reinforcement learning

extractions.description: Empirical compute study of hyper-parameter-selection consistency for two value-based deep-reinforcement-learning agents across Atari environments and two interaction budgets, introducing the THC score and releasing interactive analyses.

type.quote: This paper conducts an extensive empirical study focusing on the reliability of hyper-parameter selection for value-based deep reinforcement learning agents
type.justification: The work reports approximately 108,000 training experiments and quantitative comparisons.

name.justification: The paper directly studies and advances evaluation practice in reinforcement learning.

name.quote: Deep reinforcement learning (deep RL) has achieved tremendous success
name.justification: The central subject is hyper-parameter selection for deep-RL agents.
The empirical contribution specifically targets value-based deep-RL agents.
The paper contributes a score and empirical methodology for selecting and transferring hyper-parameters.
